title: Dynmap Tab Complete
description: Adds tab completion for Dynmap commands
body:
A simple mod that adds command completion to [Dynmap's](https://modrinth.com/mod/dynmap) ```/dynmap```, ```/dmap```, and ```/dmarker``` commands.

Currently, it only has functionality for the first argument of a command.

This is for the **FABRIC** version of Dynmap **ONLY**.
